llm_response.reason: This website exhibits several classic scam traits: unusually new domain registration (July 30, 2025) despite claiming years of experience, excessive and unrealistic promises (zero fees, 100% deposit guarantee, extremely high transaction throughput), ambiguous company information with unverifiable regulatory claims (MSB reference leads to a general page), mismatched contact email, and no legitimate company trace. The combination of these factors points to an engineered scam targeting cryptocurrency investors.
